title: Add Experimenter Tower subagent
objective: Create a new Control Tower subagent named Experimenter for running and monitoring long external processes such as Infinigen generation, SPEAR imports/cooks, and flythrough/video jobs.
instructions: Add an enabled agent id experimenter to .control-tower/state/agent-registry.json with name Experimenter, role process-orchestration, backend codex, workspace-write sandbox, search false, and dangerous bypass enabled if consistent with long-running local process work.
Create .control-tower/agents/experimenter/prompt.md and policy.yaml following the style of existing agents.

Experimenter responsibilities: start, run, monitor, and summarize long-running local processes such as Infinigen scripts, Blender/FBX export, Unreal editor imports, SPEAR cooking/packaging, flythrough/image/video generation, and simulator runtime validation helpers.
Experimenter hard rule: every long-running or user-observable process must be launched in a named tmux session/window that the user can attach to; report the exact tmux attach command.

Experimenter must monitor status/logs, preserve generated runner scripts/logs under a clearly named run directory, clean up orphaned processes only when they belong to its run, and return a ResultPacket when the process is ready, complete, failed, or blocked.

Experimenter must not edit product code by default; if a script/config fix is needed, report back to Tower or request Builder unless the packet explicitly authorizes small generated runtime config/runner files.
Update Tower prompt/default routing so process execution and monitoring requests route to Experimenter, while Builder remains product code/tests/refactors and Scribe remains docs/memory.
Mention that Tower can delegate to Experimenter exactly like built-in agents using tower-run create-packet experimenter and tower-run delegate experimenter.
constraints: Do not perform Git commits or pushes.
Keep changes scoped to .control-tower agent config/prompts/policies and concise docs/preferences if needed; no product source edits.
expected_outputs: New Experimenter agent files and registry entry.
Tower routing updated to include Experimenter.
ResultPacket listing exact files changed and any follow-up docs/memory needs.
definition_of_done: tower-run can create a packet for experimenter without registry errors.
Experimenter prompt clearly enforces tmux for long-running processes and ResultPacket handoff semantics.
